विज् {vI.v} {c3c} U. (वेवेक्ति, वेविक्ते, विक्त)
1 To separate, divide.
--2 To
distinguish, discern, discriminate (usually
with वि and allied to विच् with वि
q. v.) {vII.v} {c6c} A., {c7c} P. (विजते, विनाक्ति,
विग्न)
1 To shake, tremble.
--2 To be
agitated, tremble with fear.
--3 To
fear, be afraid; चक्रंद विग्ना कुररीव
भूयः

.
--4 To be distressed
or afflicted. --Caus. (वेजयति-ते) To
terrify, frighten.
विज् m. A bird; a die (?).

वीज् {vI.v} {c1c} A. (वीजते) To go. {vII.v}
{c10c} U. (वीजयति-ते) To fan, cool by
fanning; खं वीज्यते मणिमयैरिव
तालवंतैः

विजितृ m.
1 A discriminator, judge.
--2 A partner, coheir.

To be born or
produced.
--2 To generate, produce.
--3 To grow, arise, spring.
--4 To
be changed or transformed.

विजन a. Lonely, retired, solitary.
--नं A solitary place, retreat (विजने
means ‘privately’).

विजन्मन् a. or m. A bastard, one
born illegitimately. --n. Birth.

विजात p. p.
1 Base-born, of
mixed origin.
--2 Born, produced.
--3
Transformed.
--ता A mother,
matron, a woman who has given birth
to children.

विजातिः f.
1 Different origin,
--2
Different kind, species or tribe.

विजातीय a.
1 Of a different kind
or species, dissimilar, unlike.
--2 Of
different caste or tribe.
--3 Of mixed
origin.

विजर a. Young, fresh.
--रं A
stalk.

1 Prattle, idle or foolish
talk.
--2 Talk or speech in general.
--3 A malignant or spiteful speech.

विजल्पित p. p.
1 Spoken, talked;
परिहासविजल्पितं सखे (वचः) Ś. 2. 18.
--2 Prated, babbled.

To conquer,
defeat, overcome, subdue; व्यजेष्ट
षड्वर्गं

;
विजितारिपुरः 1. 59; Śānti. 2. 14.
--4 To be
victorious, be supreme or
pre-eminent; विजयतां देवः Ś. 5; रहस्यं
साधूनामनुपधि विशुद्धं विजयते

1 Overcoming,
vanquishing, defeating.
--2 Conquest, victory,
triumph; दिग्विजयादारभ्य ‘conquest
of the world;’

; Ś. 2. 14.
--3 A chariot
of the gods, celestial chariot.
--4 N.
of Arjuna; the Mb. thus explains
the name: --अभिप्रयामि संग्रामे यदहं
युद्धदुमदान् । नाजित्वा विनिवर्तामि तेन मांविजयं
विदुः ॥.
--5 An epithet of Yama.
--6
N. of the first year of Jupiter's
cycle.
--7 N. of an attendant of
Viṣṇu.
--Comp.
--अभ्युपायः a
means of victory.
--ईशः N. of
Śiva.
--कुंजरः a war-elephant.
--छंदः a necklace of 500 strings.
--डिंडिभः a large military drum.
--नगरं N. of a town.
--मर्दलः a large
military drum.
--सिद्धिः f. success,
victory, triumph.

.
--4
Hemp.
--5 N. of a festival = विजयोत्सव,
see below.
--6 Yellow myrobalan.
--Comp.
--उत्सवः a festival in
honour of Durgā held on the 10th
day of the bright half of Āśvina.
--दशमी the tenth day of the bright
half of Āśvina, observed as a great
holiday and commonly known as
Daśarā.
--सप्तमी the seventh day of
the bright half of a month falling
on a Sunday.

विजयिन् m. A conqueror, victor.
विजिगीषा
1 Desire to conquer or
[]
overcome.
--2 Desire to surpass
emulation, competition, ambition.

विजिगीषु a.
1 Desirous of victory,
wishing to conquer; यशसे
विजिगीषूणां

.
--2 Emulous,
ambitious.
--षुः
1 A warrior, a hero.
--2
Antagonist, a disputant, an
opponent.

विजित p. p. Subdued, conquered,
overcome, defeated.
--Comp.
--आत्मन् a. self-subdued,
selfcontrolled.
--इंद्रिय a. having the
organs of sense subdued or
controlled.

विजिह्म a.
1 Crooked, bent,
turned away; कृतं न वा कोपविजिह्ममाननं

To yawn, gape,
open the mouth; व्यजृंभिषत चापरे

.
--2 To open, expand (as a flower)
--3 To spread everywhere, pervade,
fill; सुखश्रवा मंगलतूर्यनिस्वनाः… न
केवलं सद्मनि मागधीपतेः पथि व्यजृंभंत
दिवौकसामपि

.
--5 To
spring back (as a bow).
--6 To
display activity.
--7 To become
increased or developed.

1 Gaping, yawning.
--2
Blossoming, budding, blowing,
opening; वनेषु सायंतनमल्लिकानां
विजृंभणोद्गंधिषु कुड्मलेषु

.
--3
Exhibiting, displaying,
unfolding.
--4 Expanding.
--5 Pastime,
amorous sport.

.
--2 Opened, blown,
expanded.
--3 Displayed,
exhibited, manifested;

.
--4 Appeared.
--5 Sported.
--तं
1 Sport, pastime.
--2 Wish,
desire.
--3 Display, exhibition;
अज्ञानविजृंभितमेतत्.
--4 An act, action,
conduct;

विज्जनं --लं
1 A kind of sauce;
see विजुल.
--2 An arrow.

विज्जनं --लं
1 A kind of sauce;
see विजुल.
--2 An arrow.

.
--2 To learn,
comprehend, understand.
--3 To
ascertain, find out, learn from.
--4 To
regard, know to be, consider as.
--5
To discern, discriminate,
distinguish.
--6 To be familiar with.
--7
To become wise or learned;

.
--2 To
communicate, inform.
--3 To say,
speak in general.
--4 To teach,
instruct.

विज्ञ, विजानत् a.
1 Knowing,
intelligent, wise, learned.
--2 Clever,
skilful, proficient.
--ज्ञः A wise or
learned man.

विज्ञ, विजानत् a.
1 Knowing,
intelligent, wise, learned.
--2 Clever,
skilful, proficient.
--ज्ञः A wise or
learned man.

विज्ञप्त p. p.
1 Respectfully told,
requested.
--2 Made known,
informed.

विज्ञप्तिः f.
1 A respectful
statement or communication, a request,
an entreaty.
--2 An announcement.

विज्ञात p. p.
1 Known,
understood, perceived.
--2 Well-known,
celebrated, famous.

;
5. 3; विज्ञानमयः कोशः ‘the sheath of
intelligence’ (the first of the five
sheaths of the soul).
--2
Discrimination, discernment.
--3 Skill,
proficiency; प्रयोगविज्ञानं Ś. 1. 2.
--4 Worldly
or profane knowledge, knowledge
derived from worldly experience (opp.
ज्ञान which is ‘knowledge of Brahma
or Supreme Spirit’); ज्ञानं तेहं
सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः

;
(the whole of the 7th Adhyāya of
Bg. explains ज्ञान and विज्ञान).
--5
Business, employment.
--6 Music.
--7 Knowledge of the fourteen lores.
--Comp.
--ईश्वरः N. of the author of
the Mitākṣarā, a commentary on
Yājñavalkya's Smṛti.
--पादः N. of
Vyāsa.
--मातृकः an epithet of
Buddha.
--वादः the theory of
knowledge, the doctrine taught by
Buddha.

विज्ञानिक a. Wise, learned; see
विज्ञ.

1 An informant.
--2 A
teacher, an instructor.

विज्ञापनं --ना
1 Respectful statement
or communication, a request, an
entreaty; कालप्रयुक्ता खलु
कार्यविद्भिर्विज्ञापना भर्तृषु सिद्धिमेति

कार्यविद्भिर्विज्ञापना भर्तृषु सिद्धिमेति

विज्ञापित p. p.
1 Respectfully told
or communicated.
--2 Requested.
--3
Informed.
--4 Instructed.

विज्वर a. Free from fever,
anxiety or distress.

1 The ruddy goose.
--2 A
sort of pheasant.
--नं
1 Fanning;
